packageRules.description: Deliberate migrations, carried over from dependabot.yml's ignores: no major PR until it's requested from the Dependency Dashboard
Dev dependencies minor/patch in one PR, keeping the migration packages out of it (dependabot.yml's dev-dependencies group)
React and its types move together (dependabot.yml's react group). After the dev group so @types/react lands here
Bun moves as one PR: packageManager, setup-bun's bun-version in ci.yml and the Dockerfile's oven/bun image. After the preset's GitHub Actions group so bun-version lands here
Bun minor and patch automerge on green CI: the same PR updates ci.yml, so CI runs the new Bun. Every member automerges, so the group does (majors stay with the preset's triage rule)
